user.title: Connect to Mailcow
user.description: Enter your Mailcow address and API key. HTTPS is pre-filled for convenience. The integration will first test the normal connection.

data_description.url: Enter your Mailcow hostname after https://, for example mail.example.com.
data_description.api_key: Mailcow API key with permission to read status and quarantine data.

proxy.title: Mailcow connection failed
proxy.description: Home Assistant could not connect to the Mailcow API at {url}. If the server is behind Cloudflare, a CDN, or another proxy, Home Assistant can connect directly to the Mailcow server instead.

menu_options.origin: Yes — configure Cloudflare or proxy connection

menu_option_descriptions.origin: Enter the public IP address of the Mailcow server while keeping the Mailcow hostname for secure HTTPS.
menu_option_descriptions.connection_failed: Show possible causes such as the URL, API key, or Mailcow API access settings.

origin.title: Connection through Cloudflare or another proxy
origin.description: Enter the public IP address of the Mailcow server below. Home Assistant will connect directly to that server while still using your Mailcow hostname for the secure HTTPS connection.

data_description.origin_ip: Enter only the public IPv4 or IPv6 address of the Mailcow server, for example 203.0.113.10.

connection_failed.title: Could not connect to Mailcow
connection_failed.description: Home Assistant could not authenticate or connect to the Mailcow API. Check the Mailcow address, API key, and Mailcow API access settings, then submit this screen to try again.

error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS address.
error.invalid_auth: The Mailcow server rejected the API key.
error.invalid_ip: Enter a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.
error.cannot_connect_origin: Could not authenticate or connect directly to the Mailcow server. Check the server IP, API key, and Mailcow API access settings.
error.connection_or_auth_failed: Could not authenticate or connect to the Mailcow API.

abort.already_configured: This Mailcow server is already configured.
abort.missing_connection_data: The initial Mailcow connection information was lost. Start setup again.
